1.text: Tha burden of tha word of tha LORD 2 Israel by Malachi.
I have loved u, says tha LORD. Yet y’all say, in which have u loved us? Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? says tha LORD: yet I loved Jacob,
N I hated Esau, N laid his mountains N his heritage waste 4 tha dragons of tha wilderness.

Whereas Edom says, We r impoverished, but we will return N build tha desolate places; like dis says tha LORD of hosts, dey shall build, but I will throw down; N dey shall call ’em, tha border of wickedness, N, tha people against whom tha LORD has indignation 4 ever.
N ur eyes shall see, N y’all shall say, tha LORD will be magnified from tha border of Israel.

A son honors his father, N a servant his master: if then I be a father, where is mine honour? N if I be a master, where is my fear? says tha LORD of hosts 2 u, O priests, dat despise my name. N y’all say, in which have we despised ur name?
y’all offer polluted bread upon mine altar; N y’all say, in which have we polluted u? In dat y’all say, tha table of tha LORD is contemptible.

N if y’all offer tha blind 4 sacrifice, is it not evil? N if y’all offer tha lame N sick, is it not evil? offer it now 2 ur governor; will he be pleased wit u, or accept ur person? says tha LORD of hosts.
N now, I pray u, beg God dat he will be gracious 2 us: dis has been by ur means: will he regard ur persons? says tha LORD of hosts.

Who is there even among u dat would shut tha doors 4 nothing? neither do y’all kindle fire on mine altar 4 nothing. I have no pleasure in u, says tha LORD of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at ur hand.

4 from tha risin of tha sun even 2 tha goin down of tha same my name shall be great among tha Gentiles; N in every place incense shall be offered 2 my name, N a pure offering: 4 my name shall be great among tha heathen, says tha LORD of hosts.
But y’all have profaned it, in dat y’all say, tha table of tha LORD is polluted; N tha fruit of it, even his food, is contemptible.

y’all said also, look, what a weariness is it! N y’all have snuffed at it, says tha LORD of hosts; N y’all brought dat which was torn, N tha lame, N tha sick; like dis y’all brought an offering: should I accept dis of ur hand? says tha LORD.
But cursed be tha deceiver, which has in his flock a male, N voweth, N sacrificeth 2 tha Lord a corrupt thing: 4 I am a great King, says tha LORD of hosts, N my name is dreadful among tha heathen.

2.text: N now, O y’all priests, dis commandment is 4 u.

If y’all will not hear, N if y’all will not lay it 2 heart, 2 give glory 2 my name, says tha LORD of hosts, I will even send a curse upon u, N I will curse ur blessings: yeah, I have cursed ’em already, because y’all do not lay it 2 heart.
Look, I will corrupt ur seed, N spread dung upon ur faces, even tha dung of ur solemn feasts; N one shall take u away wit it.
N y’all shall know dat I have sent dis commandment 2 u, dat my covenant might be wit Levi, says tha LORD of hosts.
My covenant was wit him of life N peace; N I gave ’em 2 him 4 tha fear wherewith he feared me, N was afraid before my name.
Tha law of truth was in his mouth, N iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked wit me in peace N equity, N did turn many away from iniquity.
4 tha priest’s lips should keep knowledge, N dey should seek tha law at his mouth: 4 he is tha messenger of tha LORD of hosts.
But y’all r departed out of tha way; y’all have caused many 2 stumble at tha law; y’all have corrupted tha covenant of Levi, says tha LORD of hosts.
Therefore have I also made u contemptible N base before all tha people, according as y’all have not kept my ways, but have been partial in tha law.
Have we not all one father? has not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning tha covenant of our fathers?
Judah has dealt treacherously, N an abomination is committed in Israel N in Jerusalem; 4 Judah has profaned tha holiness of tha LORD which he loved, N has married tha daughter of a strange god.
Tha LORD will cut off tha man dat does dis, tha master N tha scholar, out of tha tabernacles of Jacob, N him dat offers an offering 2 tha LORD of hosts.
N dis have y’all done again, covering tha altar of tha LORD wit tears, wit weepin, N wit cryin out, insomuch dat he regards not tha offering any more, or receives it wit good will at ur hand.
Yet y’all say, so? Because tha LORD has been witness between u N tha wife of ur youth, against whom u have dealt treacherously: yet is she ur companion, N tha wife of ur covenant.

N did not he make one? Yet had he tha residue of tha spirit. N so one? dat he might seek a godly seed. Therefore pay attention 2 ur spirit, N let none deal treacherously against tha wife of his youth.
4 tha LORD, tha God of Israel, says dat he hates puttin away: 4 one covers violence wit his garment, says tha LORD of hosts: therefore pay attention 2 ur spirit, dat y’all deal not treacherously.

y’all have wearied tha LORD wit ur words. Yet y’all say, in which have we wearied him? When y’all say, Every one dat does evil is good in tha sight of tha LORD, N he delights in ’em; or, Where is tha God of judgment?

3.text: Look, I will send my messenger, N he shall prepare tha way before me: N tha Lord, whom y’all seek, shall suddenly come 2 his temple, even tha messenger of tha covenant, whom y’all delight in: look, he shall come, says tha LORD of hosts.
But who may abide tha day of his comin? N who shall stand when he appears? 4 he is like a refiner’s fire, N like fullers’ soap:
N he shall sit as a refiner N purifier of silver: N he shall purify tha sons of Levi, N purge ’em as gold N silver, dat dey may offer 2 tha LORD an offering in righteousness.
Then shall tha offering of Judah N Jerusalem be pleasant 2 tha LORD, as in tha days of old, N as in former years.

N I will come near 2 u 2 judgment; N I will be a swift witness against tha sorcerers, N against tha adulterers, N against false swearers, N against dose dat oppress tha hireling in his wages, tha widow, N tha fatherless, N dat turn aside tha stranger from his right, N don’t fear me, says tha LORD of hosts.
4 I am tha LORD, I change not; therefore y’all sons of Jacob r not consumed.
Even from tha days of ur fathers y’all r gone away from mine ordinances, N have not kept ’em. Return 2 me, N I will return 2 u, says tha LORD of hosts. But y’all said, in which shall we return?
Will a man rob God? Yet y’all have robbed me. But y’all say, in which have we robbed u? In tithes N offerings.
y’all r cursed wit a curse: 4 y’all have robbed me, even dis whole nation.

Bring y’all all tha tithes in2 tha storehouse, dat there may be food in mine house, N prove me now herewith, says tha LORD of hosts, if I will not open u tha windows of heaven, N pour u out a blessing, dat there shall not be room enough 2 receive it.
N I will rebuke tha devourer 4 ur sakes, N he shall not destroy tha fruits of ur ground; neither shall ur vine cast her fruit before tha time in tha field, says tha LORD of hosts.
N all nations shall call u blessed: 4 y’all shall be a delightsome land, says tha LORD of hosts.
Ur words have been stout against me, says tha LORD. Yet y’all say, What have we spoken so much against u?
y’all have said, It is vain 2 serve God: N what profit is it dat we have kept his ordinance, N dat we have walked mournfully before tha LORD of hosts?
N now we call tha proud happy; yeah, dey dat work wickedness r set up; yeah, dey dat tempt God r even delivered.
Then dey dat feared tha LORD spoke often one 2 another: N tha LORD listened, N heard it, N a book of remembrance was written before him 4 ’em dat feared tha LORD, N dat thought upon his name.
N dey shall be mine, says tha LORD of hosts, in dat day when I make up my jewels; N I will spare ’em, as a man spareth his own son dat serves him.
Then shall y’all return, N discern between tha righteous N tha wicked, between him dat serves God N him dat serves him not.

4.text: 4, look, tha day comes, dat shall burn as an oven; N all tha proud, yeah, N all dat do wickedly, shall be stubble: N tha day dat comes shall burn ’em up, says tha LORD of hosts, dat it shall leave ’em neither root nor branch.
But 2 u dat fear my name shall tha Sun of righteousness arise wit healin in his wings; N y’all shall go forth, N grow up as calves of tha stall.
N y’all shall tread down tha wicked; 4 dey shall be ashes under tha soles of ur feet in tha day dat I shall do dis, says tha LORD of hosts.
Remember y’all tha law of Moses my servant, which I commanded 2 him in Horeb 4 all Israel, wit tha statutes N judgments.
Look, I will send u Elijah tha prophet before tha comin of tha great N dreadful day of tha LORD:
N he shall turn tha heart of tha fathers 2 tha children, N tha heart of tha children 2 their fathers, lest I come N strike tha earth wit a curse.
